description: The firm's vault of secrets by name: list what is stored, delete one. A value is collected only through the collect_secret form; this tool never takes or returns one. op: list|delete.

op.description: list: the names in the scope with their dates. delete: remove the secret named `name`.

name.description: delete: the leaf name the owner gave the secret in collect_secret.

scope.description: vault (default: read by one tool by name) or automation_env (an env var in every cmd script).
